panels.description: Sanitizer-compatible navigation bus with native keyboard focus. Primary bus 0–4: Trust / Overview / Pipeline Diagnostics / Provider Health / Data Quality. Adjunct 5–6: Incident Workspace / Run Explorer. Current workspace is a non-interactive chip (aria-disabled + data-current=page, underlined) so active state is not color-only. Handoffs open same-tab, preserve current time range, and document scope reset or context mapping on cross-scope transitions. Chip colors are theme-safe for dark and light.

Scope and evidence: provider health is determined from provider telemetry. Fleet panels cover all providers; selected-provider panels use `$provider`. Pipeline, workflow, run type, run ID, identity, and processed-record data are supporting context and do not determine provider health. Missing current-status telemetry means UNKNOWN, not healthy. Run coverage: IN RANGE / OUT OF RANGE / UNKNOWN. Set range to run when OUT OF RANGE. Effective refresh: 60s · timezone: browser. Effective filters: provider=${provider} · adapter=${adapter} · pipeline_context=${pipeline_context}.

options.content: Which provider is degraded, and why? Runtime scope: GLOBAL = fleet severity/freshness. SELECTED PROVIDER = provider status. UNKNOWN — inspect scrape target.

panels.title: Monitor Selected Provider
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Current verdict for the selected provider. Mapping: `0=OK`, `1=WARN`, `>=2=CRIT`, `null=UNKNOWN`. The verdict uses current status and successful provider activity observed in the selected range; it does not prove that a pipeline run succeeded. TELEMETRY MISSING means status evidence is unavailable—check Telemetry Freshness and Raw Health Status; it is not evidence of a healthy fleet. Fleet panels can disagree because they cover all providers.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN

panels.description: Primary action: open the worst Monitor Fleet Severity row, then confirm Monitor Telemetry Presence. Continue with Inspect Non-OK Providers and Inspect Top Provider Causes. If fleet severity is non-OK but Top Causes is empty, treat it as an explainability gap. Use selected-provider and range panels only after the fleet-level cause is understood. Full fleet/non-OK/cause tables remain in Inspect Full Fleet Evidence.

options.content: Next action: open the worst Fleet Severity row.

panels.description: CURRENT · Do not put full UUIDs into Prometheus labels. First-screen worst four providers by current status. Scope: GLOBAL provider fleet posture; intentionally not filtered by run_id. Interpret with freshness: critical -> degraded -> unknown/stale -> healthy. TELEMETRY MISSING or no data with UNKNOWN Status is a blind spot, not evidence of a healthy fleet. Complete fleet rows remain in Inspect Full Fleet Evidence.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN

panels.title: Monitor Fleet Severity

panels.description: CURRENT · Status reason and source_state for the selected provider (or worst four when provider=All). Enum 0=OK, 1=WARN, 2=CRIT, 3=UNKNOWN. missing_health_status means no health_status series — not a healthy fleet. Adapter filter is hidden; adapter=All unless a chip says otherwise. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — missing health_status for this provider, or VALID EMPTY if the selected provider has no universe row.

panels.title: Inspect Status Reason

panels.description: TIME RANGE · CURRENT · Telemetry presence of bioetl_provider_current_status for the selected provider (excluding synthetic test). 0=PRESENT means the current_status series exists. Alias mapping: PRESENT=OK (presence color only; PRESENT≠OK for fleet health). Fail-closed UNKNOWN/gray when the series is missing. MISSING_HEALTH_STATUS on Inspect Status Reason is INCOMPLETE/CRIT completeness, never PRESENT-healthy.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN

panels.title: Monitor Telemetry Presence

panels.description: TIME RANGE · Do not put full UUIDs into Prometheus labels. Only providers currently observed as DEGRADED or FAILING on the first-screen provider-status recording rule (instant/current semantics, not selected-range history). Empty table means no provider is currently above OK in the active trust window. Scope: GLOBAL provider fleet posture; intentionally not filtered by run_id. Fleet-first matrix: answer without forcing a provider selector; select row to deep-dive TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — missing/stale provider telemetry, or VALID EMPTY if the fleet has no matching rows. Not a selected-run verdict.

panels.title: Inspect Non-OK Providers

panels.description: TIME RANGE · CURRENT · Top current causes of provider degradation, bounded to the worst four rows, such as raw health, failures, retry exhaustion, latency, HTTP errors, or rate limiting. Scope: fleet; not filtered by run ID. If fleet severity is non-OK and this table is empty, check scrape and recording-rule health. Complete cause evidence remains in Inspect Full Fleet Evidence. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: UNKNOWN — missing/stale provider telemetry, or VALID EMPTY if the fleet has no matching rows. Not a selected-run verdict.

panels.title: Inspect Top Provider Causes

panels.description: Complete fleet, non-OK-provider, and cause evidence. First-screen tables stay bounded to four rows; this lane is the unbounded forensic copy. Empty domains are not a healthy-fleet verdict.

panels.title: Inspect Exhausted Retries
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Do not put full UUIDs into Prometheus labels. Selected-range evidence: retries exhausted by provider and operation in the active Grafana range. Non-zero rows identify where retry budgets were consumed, not raw provider-health enum state TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Role: snapshot table of exhausted retries over $__range; the interval trend is Track Exhausted Retries (109).

defaults.noValue: TELEMETRY MISSING — series not emitted for this selector (not a zero)

panels.title: Track Exhausted Retries
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected-range evidence: retry exhaustion trend by provider and operation over the active Grafana interval. Rising non-zero series point to persistent retry-budget pressure TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Role: $__interval trend of exhausted retries; the snapshot table is Inspect Exhausted Retries (108).

defaults.noValue: No optional health-check latency samples in range; not a provider verdict.

panels.title: Inspect Health-Check Latency p95
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Compact optional selected-range evidence: per-provider p95 health-check latency over the active Grafana range. No data means no latency samples or no probe activity in range, not 0s latency and not a provider verdict TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Role: range snapshot gauge of health-check p95; the interval trend is Track Health-Check Latency p95 (1).

defaults.noValue: No optional adapter latency samples in range; not a provider verdict.

panels.title: Track Request Latency p95
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Compact optional selected-range evidence: p95 adapter request latency by endpoint for the selected provider scope. Provider-global selected-range only; for backfill-specific stage latency open 2. Runtime with preserved pipeline/run_type/run_id scope. No data remains diagnostic and means no endpoint latency samples in range; it does not refute current provider severity TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: No optional rate-limit error samples in range; not a provider verdict.

panels.title: Track Rate-Limit Errors
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Compact optional selected-range rate-limit pressure from HTTP errors where error_type indicates throttling/rate-limit classes. Empty samples stay diagnostic and do not refute current provider severity. Use alongside Monitor Rate Limiter Wait p95 for provider-global scope TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: No optional timeout/network samples in range; not a provider verdict.

panels.title: Track Network & Timeout Errors
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Compact optional selected-range network/timeout failures separated from rate-limit pressure. Empty samples stay diagnostic and do not refute current provider severity. Provider-global scope; correlate with Runtime stage errors when pipeline handoff context is set TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: No optional rate-limiter wait samples in range; not a provider verdict.

panels.title: Track Rate-Limiter Wait p95
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Compact optional selected-range evidence: p95 wait time imposed by provider rate limiting. No data means no observed wait samples in range, not a healthy wait time. This optional telemetry can stay empty even when current provider severity is non-OK. The provider degraded-rule surface starts at p95 > 1s; this panel keeps a lower yellow band for earlier-warning inspection TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: No rate-limiter token samples in range. This remains diagnostic and does not disprove provider pressure.

panels.title: Monitor Available Rate-Limit Tokens
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Compact optional selected-range evidence: minimum provider tokens available in the active Grafana range. Lower values indicate higher rate-limit pressure; 0 means requests can be blocked. No data remains diagnostic and means no token samples were observed in range. This optional telemetry can stay empty even when current provider severity is non-OK Numeric token count is primary; sequential color is secondary. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: No circuit-breaker state samples in range. Adapter-scoped telemetry is optional and does not imply CLOSED.

panels.title: Monitor Circuit-Breaker State
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Compact cross-scope adapter diagnostics over the active Grafana range: 0=CLOSED, 1=HALF_OPEN, 2=OPEN. Uses the adapter selector because the shipped metric family is adapter-labelled rather than provider-labelled. No data remains diagnostic and does not imply a synthetic CLOSED state. This adapter-scoped telemetry can stay empty even when current provider severity is non-OK TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: No circuit-breaker trip samples in range. Adapter-scoped telemetry is optional and remains diagnostic.

panels.title: Track Circuit-Breaker Trips
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Compact cross-scope adapter diagnostics: selected-range circuit-breaker trip count by adapter over the active Grafana interval. This panel is intentionally adapter-scoped because the shipped metric family is adapter-labelled rather than provider-labelled. No data remains diagnostic and does not create synthetic adapter rows. Empty adapter telemetry does not refute current provider severity on its own TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

panels.title: Inspect Raw Health Status
panels.description: CURRENT · TIME RANGE · Do not put full UUIDs into Prometheus labels. Raw provider health enum evidence for the current first-screen scope (instant), not the canonical first-screen verdict. Values are source enum: 0=UNHEALTHY, 1=DEGRADED, 2=HEALTHY (or dashboard-local mapping). null/NaN=UNKNOWN when raw status is absent (mapping fallback), not healthy. When raw status is absent the mapped status is unknown (fail-closed), never synthetic healthy TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

panels.title: Track Health-Check Latency p95
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected-range evidence: p95 provider health-check latency over the active Grafana interval. Current provider severity is owned by the GLOBAL Provider Severity Matrix TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY. Role: $__interval trend of health-check p95; the range snapshot is Inspect Health-Check Latency p95 (102).

panels.title: Monitor Healthy Checks
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Number of HEALTHY checks completed in the selected range. `0` means none were observed or checks have not started; it is supporting evidence, not proof of current provider health. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

panels.title: Monitor Degraded Checks
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Selected-range evidence: completed DEGRADED probes in the active Grafana range. This panel is not a current-health source, so non-zero counts remain neutral evidence rather than WARN/CRIT by themselves TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.

defaults.noValue: N/A

panels.title: Track Failure Rate
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Failed checks divided by all completed checks in the selected range. Warning starts at 5%; critical starts at 20%. A zero denominator is N/A rather than success. Current provider status comes from the canonical status telemetry. VALID EMPTY (no events) is not TELEMETRY MISSING.

defaults.noValue: N/A

panels.title: Monitor Health Checks
panels.description: TIME RANGE · Total HEALTHY, DEGRADED, and failed checks completed in the selected range. `0` means no completed checks were observed or checking has not started; it is not a health verdict. TELEMETRY MISSING is not a zero and not VALID EMPTY.
Expand for selected-range and debug evidence after current fleet severity, causes, and telemetry presence have been interpreted together.

panels.title: Run Context
Inspect Run Identity
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · Do not put full UUIDs into Prometheus labels. Compact two-column local control-plane identity table. Shows Run ID, Manifest ID, Provider.Entity [Version], Contract [Schema], Execution, execution flags, Replay [Capability.Mode], Checkpoint [Anchors], optional Composite Run, and Identity Health. Exact selected run_id wins; aggregate pipeline scope without exact run_id must not guess one manifest identity; values come from HTTP, not Prometheus labels. This card is bounded pipeline/run context evidence only and does not prove current provider health. No data/datasource errors on this HTTP-backed card mean the BioETL Ops HTTP/control-plane backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting the card as expected empty. Fail-closed: timeout, empty, or unresolved identity/accounting must render UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/NO DATA — never a synthetic healthy zero

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run first. VALID EMPTY if the selected run has no identity.

panels.title: Inspect Processed Records
panels.description: SELECTED RUN · TIME RANGE · Do not put full UUIDs into Prometheus labels. Current stage/outcome accounting evidence for the shared pipeline/run_type context. Provider remains the primary health selector; this table is bounded pipeline/run_type accounting evidence and does not prove current provider health by itself. Missing accounting series render UNKNOWN/no data, not OK. Summary status, accounted subtotal, and delta rows are intentionally not displayed in this compact table; use Status, Monitor Provider Telemetry Freshness, and detailed recording rules for verdict/delta triage. No data/datasource errors on this HTTP-backed card mean the BioETL Ops HTTP/control-plane backend may be unavailable; verify /health/live before interpreting the card as expected empty. Fail-closed: timeout, empty, or unresolved identity/accounting must render UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE/NO DATA — never a synthetic healthy zero

defaults.noValue: SELECT RUN — no exact Run ID selected. Choose a run in Inspect Recent Runs. UNKNOWN/QUERY ERROR if a selected run has no accounting.

list.description: Core scope: pipeline option list from the local control-plane catalog (/ops/control-plane/filter-options?dimension=pipeline), not the Prometheus universe. PromQL current-state panels still match $pipeline against the shared universe metrics. Single-select unless this board documents All. Unknown is the fail-closed default until a source dashboard or the operator selects a concrete pipeline. A pasted var-pipeline value that exists in the catalog remains selectable even when Prometheus has no series.

list.name: pipeline

list.description: Shared operator context: run_type selector bounded by pipeline; fallback is All rather than unknown. Default run_type is backfill (SEL-P0 fallback); Include All remains available for aggregate diagnostics.

The selector defaults to - and affects only local HTTP identity panels; it MUST NOT be used in Prometheus labels or cross-dashboard handoffs. Run ID options are ordered by start time descending from the control-plane catalog; Grafana sort is disabled so backend order is preserved.

Operators may still open handoffs that pass an explicit provider value.
Hidden return context: remembers the source pipeline when Provider Health derives provider from pipeline.
